name: @tty-pt/stele
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for libstele system substrate and isomorphic C runtime contracts

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include -I/usr/include native/stele_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,../lib -L/usr/lib -lstele -o build/Release/stele_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
